summary: Verified stall pin alignment fix on /stalls (v2 artwork). Backend seed/final_layout.json coordinates were verified to exactly equal box centers (x+w/2, y+h/2) from final_layout_boxes.json for all 143 stalls (0 mismatches at tolerance 0.05%). Frontend renders 143 markers positioned via left:mapX% / top:mapY%, all pins sit centered on their labelled boxes at 100% and 250% zoom. Spot-check confirmed: Y1, X14, T1, L15, XY1 all correctly aligned. Food-court area has no pins. Hover displays stall detail tooltip (e.g. 'Y1 · Ruby Stall Available'). Zoom -/+/Fit controls work. No JS console errors. Image /api/uploads/stall-maps/final-layout.png returns 200 (image/png). /api/public/stall-directory returns 143 items. Page text shows '143 stalls on the map'. Note: request mentioned RU11/RU41 but there is no RU prefix in the layout; the Ruby series uses prefix 'Y' (Y1..Y71); those Y-row pins visually align correctly with the purple Y-row boxes.
action_items: MINOR: Stall pin markers have no data-testid (only aria-label). Adding data-testid="stall-pin-<stallNumber>" to .map-marker divs would improve automated test reliability.
INFO: Request referenced RU11/RU41 but no RU-prefix series exists; Ruby series uses Y prefix. Confirm the requester meant Y-row pins (verified aligned).
critical_code_review_comments: Coordinate integrity verified: script comparing seed/final_layout.json mapX/mapY vs box centers in final_layout_boxes.json shows exact match for all 143 stalls.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pin alignment fix is verified pixel-perfect. Coordinates in seed/final_layout.json = box centers from seed/final_layout_boxes.json exactly. If new artwork versions are introduced, re-run the coordinate diff script to guard regression.
rca of the issue: Previous misalignment was fixed by regenerating mapX/mapY as box centers (x+w/2, y+h/2). Verified numerically (0 mismatches) and visually (pins overlay boxes in both 100% and 250% zoom screenshots).
